description: This file contains a CMake function called 'json4' that parses JSON input and constructs a corresponding map structure within CMake. The function handles JSON tokenization, recognition of different JSON elements (strings, numbers, booleans, nulls, arrays, objects), and constructs nested maps and references based on the tokens.
